title: Cover refinement at a prescribed open stage
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J a small category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], D:J→X_et a diagram [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of open immersions into X [def-weil-open-immersion], and c a cone of its underlying scheme diagram. Let p:c.pt→X satisfy c.π_i followed by D(i).hom=p for every i. Fix j,k, f:k→j, any index type B, etale X-objects V_b and a covering family v_b:V_b→D(j). Let π_b:p*V_b→T be a covering family for T=(c.pt,id), with actual base change p* [def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist V′_b, v′_b:V′_b→D(k), γ_b:V′_b→V_b, and π′_b:p*V′_b→T, such that v′_b D(f)=γ_b v_b; the families v′ and π′ are covering; and p*(γ_b) π_b=π′_b. Neither affine or cofiltered or limit hypotheses nor sheaves and sections are needed.

source.place: Covering base-change construction in (3); categorical pullback stability.

proof.text: The pullback projection D(i)×_X c.pt→c.pt is mono because D(i)→X is an open immersion, and is split epi with section induced by c.π_i and id. Thus it is an isomorphism. Projection compatibility shows that p*(D(f)) is an isomorphism. Form V′_b as the actual categorical pullback of v_b and D(f) in X.Etale, with projections γ_b and v′_b; the pullback equation gives the required square. The sieve generated by v′ is the pullback of the sieve generated by v, hence covers. Since p* preserves pullbacks, each p*(γ_b) is an isomorphism. Define π′_b=p*(γ_b) π_b. Each original arrow π_b factors through π′_b using the inverse of p*(γ_b), so the sieve generated by π′ contains the original covering sieve and covers.

proof_origin.place: Covering base-change construction in (3); categorical pullback stability.

theorem affineOpenSections_refinement_data
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J]
    (D : J ⥤ X.Etale) [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom]
    (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X))
    (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p)
    (j k : J) (f : k ⟶ j) (B : Type (u + 1))
    (V : B → X.Etale) (v : ∀ b, V b ⟶ D.obj j)
    (π : ∀ b, p.Etale.obj (V b) ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))
    (hv : Sieve.ofArrows V v ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology (D.obj j))
    (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows (fun b ↦ p.Etale.obj (V b)) π ∈
      c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))) :
    ∃ (V' : B → X.Etale) (v' : ∀ b, V' b ⟶ D.obj k) (γ : ∀ b, V' b ⟶ V b)
      (π' : ∀ b, p.Etale.obj (V' b) ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)),
      (∀ b, v' b ≫ D.map f = γ b ≫ v b) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows V' v' ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology (D.obj k) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun b ↦ p.Etale.obj (V' b)) π' ∈
        c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)) ∧
      (∀ b, p.Etale.map (γ b) ≫ π b = π' b)
